cmd: date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' && echo '=== .git size ===' && du -sh /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/.git && echo '=== count-objects ===' && git -C /opt/weather-pipeline/repo count-objects -v -H && echo '=== fsck unreachable --no-reflogs (breakdown) ===' && git -C /opt/weather-pipeline/repo fsck --unreachable --no-reflogs 2>/dev/null | awk '{c[$1" "$2]++; t++} END {for (k in c) print k, c[k]; print "TOTAL", t}'
